The Haunted Man

The Haunted Man and the Ghost's Bargain, Annotated

Redlaw, a chemistry professor haunted by painful memories, is offered a gift by a ghost: the power to forget. The bargain costs him more than he expected. This was the last of Dickens's five Christmas books, published in 1848.

An annotated Kindle edition of the complete novella.

Questions

What does annotated mean?

The book includes extra notes alongside the story, such as explanations of the history and customs that a modern reader might not know.

Who wrote it?

Charles Dickens. The text is his complete original story.
